title: Inventory Companions
description: Adds different animated companions to your inventory! Choose one you like!
body: ![TITLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b4f41182c394b7601d5f57295b5a9cfa077498e.png) ## 💬 Description Inventory Companions - Client Fabric Mod which adds animated companions to your inventory. Choose one you like and look after him! **(This is a beta version, which adds only visual features)** _In future, we are planning to add features to feed him and play with him! Also there will be reaction to player's HP, weather and bioms._ ### Works with all GUIs! ### List of available companions: ### Coming soon: ### [>>> SUGGEST NEW COMPANION <<<](https://forms.gle/RjJM2CiVmQP7C9Ld8) ## ⚙️ Configuration To configure our mod you need [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)! ### Companion Choose a companion you like to see him living in your inventory. ![CHARACTER-LIST](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ebfcd4df98cdbcaad2f93f1b2e1073d1a8ce2d5_0.webp) ### Position Configure the position of the companion - in survival and in creative. ![CHARACTER-POSITION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4da951c3b3d6193f43bffcd45116579e4bab3556_0.webp)
